prompt_summary: Design a clean light evidence card for an image provenance detector. Place one abstract source-frame placeholder beside a structured context panel. Use the SynthFlag four skewed rounded-bar mark subtly.
Create a cobalt evidence summary card with four small context cells feeding one larger review state, using the SynthFlag four-bar mark.
Design an editorial template that makes a model score inseparable from its threshold, source, condition, and interpretation. Use an empty score line and blank value fields, not fabricated numbers.
Create a rigorous blank comparison figure with three horizontal rows and direct-label spaces. It must look ready for real benchmark data but contain no invented values.

Explain that changing a threshold changes the operating trade-off but not the underlying score ranking. Show one fixed ordered score line with two clearly different threshold markers; do not claim either detector is better.
Show four equal expert modules converging into one reviewable probability output. Use the four skewed rounded-bar SynthFlag mark as the organizing metaphor, but keep the diagram flat and simple.
Create an abstract two-lane review graphic showing “continue” and “flag for review” as calm operational states, not real-versus-fake verdicts. Use one cobalt signal moving between rounded cards.
Design a clear editorial callout that keeps uncertainty visible beside a detection result. Use the four-bar mark and one cobalt dot as the signal.
Create a reusable method card that foregrounds method, dataset, split, threshold, and uncertainty before any claim. Leave answer areas blank.
Create a clean image-analysis framing overlay with four cobalt corner brackets, a small four-bar mark, and minimal review labels. The center must remain open for a real image to be placed later.
Create a calm repeatable-feeling brand background derived only from the SynthFlag four skewed rounded bars, thin measurement rules, and large open fields. No logo lockup and no text.
Create a restrained dark presentation background derived from the four skewed rounded-bar mark and one measured cobalt signal line. No text.
Create a compact horizontal pill badge using the four skewed cobalt bars and a calm review-state label.
Design a blank publication-ready figure frame with a title zone, plot zone, direct-label column, and caveat footer. It must contain no data.
Create a bold but calm brand tile centered on the evidence-first promise. Use oversized editorial typography and the four skewed rounded-bar mark.
